嗨嗨嗨，大家这周过的怎么样呢，我又回来分享我生成的图片了。我每次尽量跑够40张图再发（估计应该一周一次），目前的风格是每个场景尽量都能体现一种故事感，不知道大家能不能对上我的电波。上次我看了一下，真·NSFW内容只有2张，这次补了很多R18(插入)的内容，因为这种的提示词太难想，又要搞又要让画面不是很平庸，难度有点高，我平时不爱画这种，但是有人指出来了，那我就尽量满足。
因为我不会玩e站的系统，结果上次发的莫名其妙的就被删除了，这次补上，其中，从第44张图开始是上次的图片。这周里面有几张图是用了完全不同的新的模型，不知道大家能不能分辨出来，就是新模型的肢体错误问题太严重，没那个耐心去调，所以就几张图片是。这周感冒终于好了，很爽，也希望大家永远不死。

更新通知频道：https://t.me/+sgcq5sdnYMZjMmU1

---

Hey everyone, how's your week going? I'm back again to share the images I've generated.
I usually try to generate at least 40 images before making a post (aiming for roughly once a week). My current style tries to convey a sense of story in each scene, and I wonder if you guys can catch my vibe. Last time, I noticed there were only 2 genuinely NSFW images. This time, I've included a lot more R18(sex) content. It's really challenging to come up with prompts for this kind of work. Not only do I have to create it, but I also need to make sure the image isn't mediocre, so the overall difficulty is quite high. I don't usually enjoy drawing this kind of thing, but since someone brought it up, I'll do my best to fulfill the request.
Since I'm not familiar with E-Hentai's system, my last post was inexplicably deleted. I'm re-uploading them this time; specifically, images starting from #44 are from that previous batch. A few images this week were generated using a completely new, different model. I wonder if you can tell them apart. The new model has really severe limb errors, and I just didn't have the patience to fix them all, so there are only a handful. I finally recovered from my cold this week, which feels great! I also hope you all live forever.

Discussion Group (AI-generated content only): https://t.me/+EUtHg-NUEec1NjI1
Update Notification Channel: https://t.me/+sgcq5sdnYMZjMmU1

The uncompressed images from each batch will be packaged and shared in the group. In between official posts, any good images I generate will be shared in the group first.
